Hi everyone, just a couple of performance related tweaks!

notes.title: The Double Barreled Update
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

New content update! Let's get right into the feature list:

[h2]New weapon, sawn off shotgun![/h2]
Devastating in close range, with a small magazine size and wide pellet spread to balance it out. Or unlock an extended barrel and scope for skeet style shooting!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43789406/ceb1193f500735a2fa5a69f6644e1b7bcdab04ba.gif[/img]

[h2]New sniper rifle, and tweaks to old sniper rifle.[/h2]
I've moved the DMR sniper rifle to the assault rifle category and extended it's magazine, so it plays like a semi-auto battle rifle now. In it's place is the new MR3006 bolt action sniper rifle!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43789406/3357a8b38b64d5df854922d4b25ca57f63367c4c.gif[/img]

[h2]New areas and perks[/h2]
2 new areas to find the new weapons in, along with 2 new perks which buff sniper and shotgun weapons. Perks and weapons have also been added to the rogue random pool!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43789406/b0accb7951ae5bce59389809aaaf5bc094c28c26.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43789406/ac32559dd028c837a94300d2842a839e486c2124.png[/img]

[h2]Improved aim assist[/h2]
A common request has been for a new aim assist mode that isn't as strong as the old one, and here it is! You can configure it's strength in control options and even swap back to the old mode if you prefer.

[h2]Bug fixes and QoL fixes[/h2]
[list]
Here's a list of miscellaneous stuff I fixed up too:

[*] Added inspect weapon bind for keyboard options.
[*] Add small delay to auto reloading when magazine is empty.
[*] Fixed choke perk sometimes not working.
[*] Adjusted how enemy ragdolls respond to shots from above or below.
[*] Simplified harrier and mech collision for easier grappling and performance improvements
[*] Lowered mech projectile speed a little.
[*] Fixed workshop quality check menu.
[/list]

Have fun!

-MattWLA

notes.title: Movement FPS Echo Point Nova goes roguelike as a free update adds new weapons
notes.content:
Echo Point Nova is easily one of the coolest FPS games I've ever played. Developed by Greylock Studio, who also brought us the excellent Severed Steel, it's an open-world movement shooter designed for co-op that also happens to feature a hoverboard and grapple hook. It has a profound sense of scale, incredible pace, and some of the slickest mobility the genre has ever seen. If you yearn for the Titanfall 3 that might never come, this is easily the next next thing.

Read the rest of the story...

RELATED LINKS:
Titanfall lives again with fast paced FPS Echo Point Nova, out now
Co-op FPS demo inspired by Tony Hawk's Pro Skater gets a big overhaul
Doom, Titanfall, and Tony Hawk combine in a co-op FPS you can play now

notes.title: HUGE content update NOW LIVE!
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

Big day for owners of Echo Point Nova! Let's go over the major new content:

[h2]Rogue Mode[/h2]
Accessed from the new game menu, Rogue Mode is a new way to play EPN with randomized items, randomized spawns, an XP based level up system, an in-game item shop, and wave based combat. Supports singleplayer and co-op play, and a new achievement for beating the final challenge.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43789406/0fedf664cecf0f8c1a23df92507e55fad3d6503b.gif[/img]

[h2]Weapon wheel[/h2]
You asked and we delivered! As a bonus, weapon wheel and power wheel slow down time (in singleplayer) while you make you choice.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43789406/ab108df83127c984ca369c4c108bd1ae01efd876.gif[/img]

[h2]New guns[/h2]
A belt fed machine gun and new super-high rate of fire SMG!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43789406/6df156dd12dc5afaed49ee09a808707199cc5bec.gif[/img] 

[h2]New perks[/h2]
Try out Super Style, which slows down time whenever you are flipping, and Short Circuit, which gives you a heal whenever you destroy a mech enemy!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43789406/6ab290a675c294858eb6b9e3605166d512b084b8.gif[/img]


[h2]New islands[/h2]
Find the new gear on 2 new islands, look for Erebus in the arctic biome and Ironwood in the lava biome!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43789406/e03013c90729d523c75ceef64b0f49493d45123e.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43789406/e9e85ab96729bf3e0ad0f3b88a444adecb257f27.png[/img]

[h2]New board stickers[/h2]
Thanks to community member Positato!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43789406/5f625273e7fefb423b25c7b221288b2710b0e667.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43789406/476030c19aeb487db53b6ed5ce530db148a1e9d1.png[/img]

[h2]More![/h2]
See the full changelog below for lots of quality of life improvements, performance improvements, and bug fixes.

[b]Thanks a ton for playing the game! I hope you enjoy the new content and more is coming in the future.

-Matt[/b]





[b]FULL CHANGELOG:[/b]

[b]New Features[/b]
[list]
[*] Rogue Mode added.
[*] Weapon Wheel: Players can now access a weapon wheel, in singleplayer time slows while using gear wheels.
[*] New Islands: Erebus and Ironwood added to the world.
[*] New Perks: Super Style and Shortcircuit.
[*] New Weapons: LMG and XYZ.
[*] New Stickers available.
[/list]

[b]Balance & Quality of Life[/b]
[list]
[*] If an NPC dies by suicide during a scan without taking player damage, the death no longer counts for the scan kill.
[*] Explosive hits now affect mech weak points.
[*] Mechs now wear hats when the hat mod is enabled.
[*] Voxel destruction radius increased for all player explosives.
[*] Breaching Tool Perk now causes larger voxel destruction.
[*] Time Magazine now throws a grenade instead of dropping it.
[*] Shock Magazine now activates during any reload.
[*] Enemies cannot shoot within 2–3 seconds of spawning.
[*] Headshots with the Silly Hats Modifier now emit confetti.
[*] Enemy movement speed tweaks.
[*] High-level enemy HP lowered.
[*] Suppressor adjustment: Now only reduces bullet velocity by 10% and grants a headshot damage bonus.
[/list]

[b]Bug Fixes & Performance[/b]
[list]
[*] Optimized performance for explosion effects.
[*] Workshop maps no longer update while playing in singleplayer.
[*] Fixed a bug where the auto shotgun sometimes wouldn’t ADS.
[*] Fixed crashes and weird behavior when a player tried to leave an active scan area.
[*] Fixed an issue where clients in co-op scans would keep unnecessary areas loaded.
[*] Fixed a bug where extra Colossi turrets would spawn in co-op.
[*] NPC hat fit polished.
[*] Various UI changes for Steam Deck verification.
[*] Fixed a bug where the gamepad couldn't select the respawn button.
[*] Improved hammer hit detection on NPCs for clients.
[*] Fixed Freeze Power and Fire Power for clients.
[*] Holstered weapons now properly remember if they have an extended mag.
[*] Fixed cases where No Ammo and No HP mods wouldn’t work.
[*] Tanky Enemies Modifier now increases enemy health by 50% (previously 300%).
[*] Supply crate drops now adjust based on No Ammo and No Health challenges.
[*] Increased damage particle size when bullets break voxels.
[*] Enemy movement speed rebalanced at higher difficulties (some high-level enemies previously moved slower than intended).
[*] Between-hit on player cooldown now skips for higher difficulty enemies (except shotgunners).
[*] Reduced projectile speed multiplier for high-difficulty enemies.
[*] Paint particles are now flashier.
[*] Bullet hole and paint splat fade distances increased.
[*] Hitting enemies with paint now emits paint effects.
[*] Fixed gamepad turn rate being affected by framerate.
[*] Best For Last Perk no longer applies to explosives.
[/list]

notes.title: Hotfix
notes.content:
Some small fixes!

[list]
[*] Fix speedometer not appearing.
[*] Fix zone discovery and completionist achievements not granting.
[/list]

And a quick thank you to the community! There is a stereotype about gamers that they can be demanding and mean customers, but to be honest my experience has been the total opposite. I sometimes break features during the big updates and 100% of the time you are all cool, patient, and even help me debug the issue while I roll out multiple attempts to fix. So I want to give a huge thanks to everyone reading this as you are likely the kind of cool customer I feel so lucky to have!

P.S. I've started working with an artist to bring a double barreled sawn-off to the game... we are just getting started so I can't guarantee anything yet or offer a timeline but maybe SOON-ish?!

notes.title: 1 month check-in!
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

It's been 1 month since Echo Point Nova launched so I thought it was time for a check-in about post-launch content! I've had some time to chat with the community and ponder things. Here is what I plan for the near future:

[h2]Steam Workshop Support For Custom Levels[/h2]
[b]My goal is for the levels you download to implement seamlessly into the overworld[/b], so every level you download finds some space in the open world to exist, and you can surf and grapple your way there like any other island in the base game!

[b]Progression and item hunting is an important part of Echo Point Nova, and I'd like that to carry over to workshop maps.[/b] My idea is that level makers can place down "Workshop Orbs" which will behave a lot of like agility orbs but allow the player to unlock new cosmetics. Completing scans on workshop levels could also work towards this.

By the way, on the [url=https://discord.gg/ntqedaMEJa]Discord [/url] we have some people already working on levels and testing beta Workshop support, here's some screens! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43789406/c12043b019641204924d567255cd18ff30220f7c.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43789406/7439d4f0fefc9bc75a6c7e2a09cd7743c9786a7e.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43789406/ea825ab602138f594e1e14064c6212a0f57e4007.png[/img]

Thanks to Fug and Positato for the custom levels! My goal is to launch workshop support sometime Q4 2024.

[h2]New Game Plus[/h2]
[b]Echo Point Nova is very much a sandbox game so I think there is a lot of potential for infinite replay-ability. [/b] My idea for New Game Plus is a very customizable game mode where you will have a bunch of options to choose from, here's some random ideas I'm considering:
[list]
[*] Carry over weapons, perks, and/or health from previous save
[*] Randomize starting spawn location.
[*] Randomize artifact locations.
[*] Buffed enemy difficulty and/or count.
[*] Randomize perk, weapon, and hat locations.
[*] Randomize bonus scan conditions.
[/list]
So the idea is, after you complete the game, you can start over and have some choice in exactly how your second playthrough is different. I think this, combined with workshop support, should give the game some serious replayability. 

[b]If you've read this far I greatly appreciate it! And please leave a review for the game! We are bouncing between 99% and 98% positive now and I'd love to make our 99% status more solid.[/b]

As for other random news, the OST is currently under review by Valve and should be ready for release very soon!

Thanks for reading,

Matt

( thanks for ThunderBrush for the sweet cover art! https://x.com/ThunderBrush )

notes.title: Launch day info!
notes.content:
[h2]Hi everyone![/h2]

[b]Echo Point Nova launches very soon! Or maybe even has launched depending on when you read this! Here is a bunch of info you might find interesting or helpful! [/b]

[h2]Steam Deck Support?[/h2]

Steam Deck is fully supported! I'm awaiting Valve approval but during development I played on Deck all the time. On my OLED model frames are often 50+ with default settings, although there are dips in very dense combat encounters or when big areas load in. Over time I plan on optimizing more!

Here is some Steam Deck footage to give you an idea how it looks and runs!
[previewyoutube=EkedOjtCt04;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Roadmap and Level Editor![/h2]

Like Severed Steel I plan on some interesting free content updates in the future! EPN launches with a level editor, and Workshop support is one of my first plans. I'd like to figure out with the community the best way to handle it, I'm leaning towards something super-seamless (like workshop content gets loaded into overworld from map menu, so its like fast travelling anywhere in game) but there are pros and cons to that. 

Anyways the roadmap is a hybrid roadmap / idea pool. I really need to see what players respond to in order to make smart decisions about updates. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43789406/8a1338ee108de3ac488da9bc9f2f8dab1b8e8a30.png[/img]
[url=https://discord.gg/ntqedaMEJa]Discord Invite[/url]

[h2]OST?[/h2]

Yes we will be releasing the OST soon! We are making sure it is complete and polished and didn't think we could do it justice AND launch on launch day.

[b]But it's over 70 tracks lol, Floating Door went hard.[/b]

[h2]What's In The Game?[/h2]

[b]Ok if you don't want ANY spoilers, even light ones, leave![/b]


















So a good way to understand it is to compare to the demo. You might remember a big chunk of the demo was the metal halfpipe highway section, I've marked an area roughly the same size of it on this picture of the full game map [b](look for the red U shape)[/b]:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43789406/264b96b4c1bd0adaa7bb77664bf0d658d8823017.png[/img]

So as you can see much bigger! The demo had 4 scan fights, whereas the full game has 34. There's also 45 hats, 54 perks, 200 agility orbs, 19 firearms, 4 offhand powers, and 4 colossi bosses. There is a main quest which has you hunting for underground artifacts, sometimes with your pickaxe, between scan fights and colossi fights. And then of course there's lots to do after the credits roll! 

That's it for now! Thanks a bunch for reading, and I hope you enjoy the game! I'll be reading [url=https://discord.gg/ntqedaMEJa]Discord[/url] and the Steam discussion board, so please post your thoughts and ideas!

-Matt

(thanks to Michael Potok [VA of backpack enemies in Sev Steel and Professional enemy type in EPN] for the Steamdeck picture!)

notes.title: Echo Point Nova Demo Update .71
notes.content:
**Experimental** PVP. (Its really just a friendly fire option with some rules changes when its on). To try, each player should find the new PvP module hidden underneath the very first island. This doesn’t mean I’m planning on a real PvP mode, I’m just trying things out.

New module: One hit kill. Some players wanted even more challenge. Hidden beneath the first island is a module which makes you die in one hit. Have fun!

Graphics toggle to turn off camera shake

New aim sensitivity options: Can set separate aiming and regular sensitivity, can also set seperate pitch and yaw sensitivity for each.

notes.title: Echo Point Nova Demo V.5
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

Wow a patch every day this week. To be honest I didn't plan to do that, but I've been getting a lot of helpful feedback and didn't see the point in waiting around to make some changes.

Today's patch lets co-op players revive friends in arena mode, to revive a friend the team needs to score 7 kills after the friend goes down. In brief testing it felt fair but let me know how it goes.

I've also made some tweaks to the hardest difficulty and cleaned up various bugs.

I'll be AFK this weekend, and next week I plan to observe feedback for the game as is for a while and let people digest the game for a bit. However if anything critical is found I'll patch it.

Thanks for reading,

-MattWLA


[h2]Major changes:[/h2]
[list]
[*] If a coop player dies in an arena fight, living team members can recover them by getting 7 kills.
[*] Hard difficulty now has protection against 1 hit kills, and small cooldown between hits on player (.5s).
[/list]

[h2]Minor changes:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fix clipping issues when sliding while bolting or reloading sniper rifle.
[*] Fix bug in coop where camera bugs out after spectating teammate.
[*] Fix players getting stuck on turrets.
[*] Fix UI not updating for arena kills left.
[*] Fix enemy total count not scaling for coop arena fights.
[/list]

notes.title: Echo Point Nova demo v.4
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

This patch is focused on the orb arena fights. I've given players more control over when they start, and made the fights more consistently intense. No more hunting down the last few stragglers!

I've also reduced some of the annoying traits of the enemy types and fixed an assortment of bugs.

And finally I adjusted the overall lighting of the world to give a little more contrast.

Please let me know what you think!

-MattWLA


[h2]Major changes:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Change how orb arena fights work: Players no longer need to hunt down last few stragglers. A high amount of enemies is kept stocked and players win when they hit a target kill count. Remaining enemies die and drop pickups for pickup extravaganza.
[*] Changed how orb arena fights start: Players can activate instantly with button press, no longer proximity and wait based. All players on server need to activate.
[*] Dimmed skylight, changed skylight color temp
[/list]
[h2]Minor changes:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Limit 2 shield guys at once per arena fight
[*] Reduced shield guy HP
[*] Made shield guy look 50% more intimidating
[*] Tweaked quest text for find the hoverboard quest
[*] Slowed AR reload speed
[*] Add sound to jumping units as they jump
[*] Tweaked some ledges in first ruin
[*] Lowered difficulty of second arena fight
[/list]
[h2]Bug fixes:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Disable motion blur on fire particles (performance improvements near fire particles)
[*] Can reliably interrupt shotgun and bolt action reloads
[*] Fixed bugs where shotgun and bolt action would soft lock
[*] HUD graphics are now immediately updated after binds changes
[*] Fix countdowns counting down even in pause menu
[*] Fix shotgun and sniper ammo going into negatives (not sure, untested)
[/list]

notes.title: Demo Patch Notes v.3
notes.content:
Hi everyone, thanks for playing and thanks for the feedback!

A lot of people said there was too much ammo, and that it was kind of slow and not fun to swap weapons during combat. So I made some adjustments to how ammo and swapping weapons works! Please let me know what you think after you try out the changes!

-MattWLA


Major changes:
[list]
[*] Weapon magazines refill after 2.5 seconds holstered
[*] Speed up weapon swap time about 2X
[*] Add gameplay option to auto swap weapon when magazine empty.
[*] Pickups player doesn't need (e.g. at full health, full on ammo type) go greyscale, have color when needed.
[/list]

Ammo economy tweaks:
[list]
[*] Certain enemy types drop certain ammo types (before, enemies dropped whatever player was lowest on)
[*] standard grunts drop pistol, rifle, and smg ammo. 
[*] shotgunners drop shotgun ammo. 
[*] jumpers drop rifle and sniper ammo
[*] Reduced ammo pickup values: pistol 50->12, smg 50->12, sniper 10->4, shotgun 8->4, rifle 30->12
[*] Reduced max carryable ammo limits on all weapons: shotgun 24->16, Sniper 30->21, Assault rifle, 150->120, SMG 240->150, Pistol 240->100
[/list]

Minor changes:
[list]
[*] Halfed AR recoil, %80 ROF, doubled damage, reduced max ammo from 180->150
[*] Made shotgun spread more useful
[*] increased shotgun shot volume
[*] fixed wrong slots being assigned in inventory menu
[*] fix issue where arm clips into camera with bolt action (only scoped, other clipping issues in progress)
[*] wider pickup range for pickups
[*] pickups respawn when orb fight lost
[/list]
